title: Stupid Cars
description:
Stupid Cars is pure chaotic fun!Speed cars up. Slow them down. Keep everything moving… and avoid total disaster.

Vehicles never stop — and if they crash, it’s game over.

Easy to pick up, hard to master. The perfect “one more go” arcade challenge.

FEATURES• VR or Flatscreen – Play your way

• Hand Tracking or Controllers (VR) – Direct, intuitive control

• 9 Unique Levels – Each with its own twist of chaos

• Cruise Control System – Build it up for special rewards

• Turbo & Overtake Modes – High risk, high reward gameplay

• Global Leaderboards – Compete with friends and the world

• 15 Achievements – For players chasing perfection

MORE• Clean, polished visuals with charming animations

• Catchy original soundtrack

• Quick sessions, perfect for casual play

• Optional depth for high-score chasers

VR DETAILS• Adjustable play height – get right down into the action

• Designed for both seated and standing play
description_short: Stupid Cars is pure chaotic fun! Speed cars up and slow them down — they never stop. One crash and it’s game over. Easy to learn, hard to master. The ultimate “one more go” arcade challenge. Play in VR or Flatscreen with 9 levels, leaderboards, achievements, and Turbo modes.
